cues.text: In a back corner at the foot of a stairway, beside a vending machine, three young men stand around Yukari.
You run up and stop a few steps behind Yukari.
You walk past Yukari and plant yourself between her and the men.
You take a fighting stance, and the fight with the three men is quick. When it is over the men are gone, and you stand alone with Yukari.
Yukari turns and walks away, leaving you behind.
